pcvs.name: nets
pcvs.expression: getNets().size(), including nets with no shape in the box

pcvs.name: layers
pcvs.expression: sum over nets of the layers where the net has any shape

pcvs.name: v
pcvs.expression: sum over nets of the vertices of the pins initNet builds

pcvs.name: f
pcvs.expression: sum over nets of fixed shapes (fixed polygon rectangles and fixed cut rectangles)

factors.criterion: a per-net term independent of the net's shapes, from passes that walk every layer of the technology (21) whether the net has shapes there or not
content terms (pin vertices, fixed shapes, layers with shapes) separate from the per-net term

fix.effect: nets coefficient falls from 20,489 to 2,323 (-89%); content terms unchanged

drperf.units: instructions per region call; [formula, unexplained percent]; small_formula_at_large in percent of the measured large total

grading: Semantic review against the record and code, not keyword matching. Equivalent expressions and well-supported alternative decompositions count. Coefficients are measured on this build and machine and are not acceptance thresholds.
scope: The case's scenario at the listed sizes on the standalone extraction; not an all-input guarantee and not a claim about OpenROAD's full router.
